text:
[RFCS.7a.4] **An engine withdrawal is recorded before everything its evaluation produces.** When the engine withdraws a fact, whatever the cause ([RFCS.7a.2]), it **must** record the `FactWithdraw` before every atom the withdrawal's evaluation produces: the faults raised while the network re-evaluates without the fact, and the `FactWithdraw` of every fact the withdrawal cascades into. Each cascaded withdrawal is in turn recorded before what its own evaluation produces.

This is the order [RFCS.6.7] gives a host retract, applied to the engine's own withdrawals: a cause precedes its consequences in the stream. A replayer re-derives the withdrawal and what follows it, and compares them in this order ([RFCS.7a.3]).

The clause orders a withdrawal against its own consequences only. Where a superseded fact's withdrawal falls relative to its successor is [RFCS.6a.4]'s.
